title: An extra beat every minute - Nature Energy
gist: A Nature Energy news-and-views piece (preview only) summarizes research finding that a disturbance recurs precisely every minute in grids worldwide, caused by clock-synchronized self-tests in battery-based uninterruptible power supplies acting in unison.

insights.claim: Small grid frequency deviations are routinely attributed to stochastic fluctuations in load and generation, but new research finds a disturbance recurring precisely every minute in grids worldwide.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Challenges the assumption that minor frequency noise is random; grid-balancing and reserve design may need to account for deterministic digital effects.

insights.claim: The recurring disturbance is attributed to clock-synchronized self-tests in battery-based uninterruptible power supplies that inadvertently act in unison.
insights.speaker: Nature Energy
insights.so_what: Software scheduling in UPS and battery fleets, including data-centre backup, is a grid-stability variable to watch.
